confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Brno price levels, not from live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hotel anchors, which vary more by season and property. The FX value comes from an RBA homepage snippet returned by search and was not checked against the F11.1 daily table; a third-party site reported 0.6947 for 2026-10-16, consistent with it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Czech regional pricing, benchmarked against Prague's non-central venues and other mid-sized Central European cities such as Bratislava and Ostrava, adjusted for Brno's lower tourist premium.
